result.summary: Independently re-ran and re-verified rather than trusting TEST-RUNNER's report, at commit f213d71 on feature/WF02-REQ-017. `npm run lint`: exit 0, same 2 pre-existing @next/next/no-img-element warnings in apps/web (Footer.tsx/Nav.tsx, unrelated to this diff), no errors. `npm run build`: exit 0 for both apps/web (Next.js/Turbopack, TS check passed) and apps/bot (tsc -p tsconfig.json, no output). `npx vitest run` (apps/bot): 16 files, 204 tests, all passed -- matches the report exactly, re-run myself, not copied. Read the full REQ-017 design doc (docs/agents/design/REQ-017.md) myself and mapped each of the 6 ACs to code before checking test output. Spot-checked, with my own commands and fresh fixtures rather than reading the prior report's numbers: (1) 24h-time-format fix -- read apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.ts, confirmed `hourCycle: 'h23'` is set explicitly and the file's own comment documents why (Intl otherwise defaults en-US to 12h/AM-PM); independently ran a standalone Intl.DateTimeFormat script for both ru-RU/en-US at exactly midnight UTC (the boundary case not explicitly in the existing vitest suite) -- both render '00:00' with no AM/PM, confirming the fix holds at the boundary, not just mid-day. (2) AC3 (computed-never-stored, live) -- stood up the scratch Postgres (docker-compose.yml, bounded pg_isready poll capped at 30 iterations x 2s, not unbounded), ran `npx drizzle-kit migrate`, inserted my own fixture rows via raw psql (a fresh chapter/venue/event with capacity 5 and 2 admitted registrations), then ran a standalone tsx script calling the actual exported `countAdmittedRegistrations`/`computeSeatsLeft` functions and reading `events.updated_at` via raw SQL before and after: admittedCount=2, seatsLeft=3, updated_at identical before/after (2026-09-06 20:09:28.983475+00 both times) -- confirmed zero writes from the read path, using my own script, not the prior report's numbers. (3) AC6b (finished-but-published exclusion, the specific gap REQ-016 left open) -- added a second fixture event with status='published' and ends_at 1 hour in the past, called the real `listUpcomingPublishedEvents` export directly: the finished event was excluded from the result while the still-upcoming AC3 event was included, confirming both the query's `ends_at > evaluationTime` filter (event.ts:890) and (via code read) the deep-link handler's independent `isFinished` check (handlers/start.ts:120-122) gate the same case at both call sites the design requires. Also independently git-grepped `seats_taken|seats_left|registration_open|finished` across apps/bot/src myself: every match is either a pure function/parameter name or comment prose (including db/schema.ts:144-145's documentation comment, which the report correctly identified as not a violation); confirmed `git diff master...HEAD -- apps/bot/src/db` is empty (no schema change). Independently ran `git grep -in wishlist apps/bot/src` (no matches) and read i18n/types.ts's events block (11 keys) plus index.ts:83's single `/events` registration, confirming AC6c/AC-catalog by direct read rather than trusting the report's count. Confirmed full requirement scope: git status clean on the branch both before and after my own scratch script (created and deleted apps/bot/src/rv_verify_ac3_ac6b.ts, confirmed removed via git status --porcelain), no stray TODO/FIXME/XXX in apps/bot/src, and every file the design doc names (domain/event.ts, domain/venue.ts, i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.ts, handlers/event.ts, handlers/start.ts, i18n/types.ts/ru.ts/en.ts, index.ts) present and each showing REQ-017's own changes. Reviewed TEST-RUNNER's 3 flagged MINOR test-spec issues (fixture cleanup FK order, AC4 grep bluntness, AC6d wording) -- agree these are real but non-blocking spec-precision defects, not implementation defects (independently confirmed all three read correctly in the current spec text); filed docs/issues/ISS-0011.yaml to track them for a future TEST-DESIGNER pass rather than letting them go untracked.
